summary: WAYLOAM v0.2.6.alpha fixes update-state handling, improves slider contrast, and makes Android back navigation return to Home instead of closing the app from a secondary screen.
highlights: Settings now shows UP TO DATE after installing the latest version instead of offering the same APK again.
The daily-target slider inactive segment has stronger contrast against its container while staying inside the WAYLOAM palette.
Android's back gesture returns Plan, Ride, Gear, Safety and Settings to Home.
added: Version-aware tracking for downloaded update APKs so stale installers are never reused for a newer release.
changed: Update checks bypass HTTP caches and compare the latest manifest against the installed version code.
Inactive slider track color now uses a translucent secondary tone instead of matching the card background.
Back navigation is handled at the app-section level: secondary destinations go Home first.
fixed: Fixed the updater repeatedly offering the version that is already installed.
Fixed completed old downloads remaining visible after an app update.
Fixed the daily-target inactive track blending into its container.
Fixed Android back exiting WAYLOAM from non-Home sections.
